hero.title: South Carolina Republicans Block Effort to Redraw James Clyburn District
hero.intro: South Carolina Republicans unexpectedly blocked a redistricting proposal that could have eliminated Democratic Congressman James Clyburn’s congressional seat, defying pressure from Donald Trump.
hero.author: The Quest for Profit
hero.contentLeft: The failed vote exposes deep divisions inside the GOP over aggressive mid-decade redistricting strategies.
hero.contentRight:
Representative James Clyburn's district remains the center of a national battle over voting rights and racial representation.

The decision marks a significant setback for Trump-backed efforts to strengthen the Republican House majority.
